The fetch function a chart's spec asks for

fetch_fn_for_chart.Rd

Most charts fetch straight from the database. A chart with aggregate = "Q" in charts.csv gets its monthly data collapsed to quarters first, via quarterly_fetch. Chart-level by necessity: the wide table has one period column, so every series on a chart shares a frequency.

Usage

fetch_fn_for_chart(chart, base_fetch, min_obs = 3L)

Arguments

chart

one row of the charts table

base_fetch

the underlying fetch function

min_obs

passed to aggregate_to_quarters

Value

a function with base_fetch's signature
